name: South Carolina
status_why: Clarity answered scripts; the kit already reads it.
office: the South Carolina State Election Commission
system: Clarity Elections (Scytl) at www.enr-scvotes.org, the State Election Commission's results site, with every county as a sub-site.

results_page.label: South Carolina State Election Commission: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: scvotes.gov's results page in late October.

feeds.address: https://www.enr-scvotes.org/SC/<electionId>/current_ver.txt -> <ver>; then .../<electionId>/<ver>/json/en/electionsettings.json, .../<ver>/json/status.json, .../<ver>/reports/summary.zip and detailxml.zip (detail XML: every contest, county, vote type)
feeds.updates: A new version number on every upload, every few minutes on election night.
feeds.note: current_ver.txt for 126294 (June 9 primary) answered 375593 on 2026-10-09 (CloudFront). The site's front page is an Angular app ('List Elections'); the elections are linked from scvotes.gov/elections-statistics/election-results/.

feeds.address: https://www.enr-scvotes.org/SC/<County>/<countyElectionId>/... (same Clarity layout per county; ids listed in the state election's settings)
feeds.note: County contests are reported on the county sub-sites.

races_in_feed: Everything run by the Commission and the county boards: federal, statewide, legislature, solicitors, county council, school boards, and the city and special-district elections held on Nov 3 (which may be separate elections in the system).
local: County results are sub-sites of the same Clarity host; Charleston, Greenville, Richland, Horry also post on their own pages (not checked).
how_counted: South Carolina reports votes by type: Election Day, early, absentee and provisional.
count_order: Clarity detail XML VoteTypes (Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee by Mail, Failsafe, Provisional).
vote_types: Yes: Clarity detail XML gives each choice's votes by VoteType (in South Carolina usually Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee by Mail, Failsafe, Provisional); confirm on the replay.

certify.body: the South Carolina Board of State Canvassers
certify.rule: Convenes within 10 days of the election and may sit up to 15 days (S.C. Code 7-17-220, 7-17-230).
certify.local_rule: Counties by noon on the Saturday after the election (7-17-20).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Live-readable, and the kit already has the reader. On election night poll current_ver.txt every 2 to 3 minutes; when it changes, fetch summary.zip for the totals and detailxml.zip (vote types, counties) less often. Read the county sub-sites for local contests. The same code serves West Virginia.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
